rv.q: "Album" blends those two ideas in a creative, emotionally resonant, and frequently funny world premiere musical that tackles the raw, transformative journey of healing intergenerational trauma.
Album is the kind of new musical that feels destined for a Broadway future.
Aury Krebs is outstanding as the grown-up Mia, with a rich and precise coloratura voice that can perform MILCK’s signature staccati singing style, and a warm, funny and engaging stage presence.
All of the actors nail their numbers, making the musical tight and polished.

cn.t: Critics praise this heartfelt world premiere musical for its emotional resonance and indie-pop score, calling it a moving exploration of family dynamics, unresolved trauma, and self-acceptance that blends heart, humor, and song.
